title: Ghost Hand
synopsis: This is Part 2 of our rendition of “Ghost Hand”.

fullText.simplified:
文华最近咳嗽得厉害，为了不影响她的丈夫睡觉，所以两人不睡在同一边，而是睡在床的两头。但是这晚睡觉之前，她要求和丈夫互换了方向。原因是：丈夫睡的那头有床头灯，方便她晚上睡不着的时候开灯。
    这不，才不到一个小时，文华已经开灯关灯四五次了。同时，她还把丈夫叫醒了好几回。最后丈夫生气了，她才不敢再去叫醒他。
    文华睡不着，或者说是她不敢睡着。她总想着那只“鬼手”，总有一种不安的感觉。
又过了半个小时，文华还是睡不着。没办法，她起身，找到丈夫的安眠药，吃了两片。这个药很厉害，不多久，文华就睡着了。
    不知道睡了有多久，黑暗中，有一样东西，把她惊醒了。那是一只手在轻轻地摸着她的脖子。她半睡半醒，忘了她和丈夫并没有睡在一头。刚开始她还以为是她的丈夫在摸她。她想把这只手拿开，但是全身无力，连一根手指都抬不起来。
    又过了一会儿，一件可怕的事情发生了！她第二次感觉到有一只手在摸她的脖子。但这只手和第一只手不一样，这只手很冷很冷，比冰还冷。
    “呀！鬼手！”这是文华的第一感觉。她害怕极了，同时也完全清醒了。她清楚地感觉到那只手的手指是那么的冰，指甲是那么的长。她想到了晚上看的鬼片，想到了杀死那个律师的鬼手。她害怕极了，全身都在冒着冷汗。她想叫人，但是又叫不出声来。
    就这样不知过了多长时间，她只觉得时间过得很慢很慢。最后，她晕过去了。
    第二天，李时醒来后，发现妻子的脸像火一样红，还一直在说着梦话。他摸了摸她的头，热度高得厉害。李时跳了起来，把文华叫醒。文华醒来后还是很害怕，她哭着告诉了李时昨天晚上发生的事情。
    一个小时后，医生来了。医生看了一下后，说：“她是因为受到了极度的惊吓才生病的。现在她需要安静地休息，不能再受到惊吓了。像她这样胆小的人，根本就不应该看鬼片或者是听鬼故事。”
    在医生给文华看病的时候，又发生了一件奇怪的事情。那个医生发现文华的床上有一种奇怪的味道。他在文华的床旁边找到了一块布，那味道就是从那块布上发出的。那是迷药的味道。
    但是医生不是侦探，所以他看完病后就走了。
    这时，那个不请自来的朱龙也来到了李时夫妇的家。李时把昨天晚上发生的事情告诉了朱龙。
    “为什么会有迷药呢？”李时感到很奇怪，他看向朱龙，说：“你是个聪明人。你来说说看吧！”
    “哈哈！这样奇怪的事情，我哪里知道为什么。这要问问福尔摩斯大侦探才行了。”朱龙笑道。
    “可是中国没有福尔摩斯。”
    “中国虽然没有福尔摩斯，但是有霍桑大侦探呀！”
    朱龙鼓励李时打电话给霍桑大侦探，让他来解开这个难题。李时是个公子哥儿，他觉得打电话太麻烦。于是，朱龙找出了电话号码，半开玩笑似的打给了霍桑。朱龙以为侦探事务所很忙，不会有时间处理这样的小事。没想到，电话里说：“你们等会儿，我马上就到。”
fullText.traditional:
文華最近咳嗽得厲害，為了不影響她的丈夫睡覺，所以兩人不睡在同一邊，而是睡在床的兩頭。但是這晚睡覺之前，她要求和丈夫互換了方向。原因是：丈夫睡的那頭有床頭燈，方便她晚上睡不著的時候開燈。
    這不，才不到一個小時，文華已經開燈關燈四五次了。同時，她還把丈夫叫醒了好幾回。最後丈夫生氣了，她才不敢再去叫醒他。
    文華睡不著，或者說是她不敢睡著。她總想著那隻“鬼手”，總有一種不安的感覺。
又過了半個小時，文華還是睡不著。沒辦法，她起身，找到丈夫的安眠藥，吃了兩片。這個藥很厲害，不多久，文華就睡著了。
    不知道睡了有多久，黑暗中，有一樣東西，把她驚醒了。那是一隻手在輕輕地摸著她的脖子。她半睡半醒，忘了她和丈夫並沒有睡在一頭。剛開始她還以為是她的丈夫在摸她。她想把這隻手拿開，但是全身無力，連一根手指都抬不起來。
    又過了一會兒，一件可怕的事情發生了！她第二次感覺到有一隻手在摸她的脖子。但這隻手和第一隻手不一樣，這隻手很冷很冷，比冰還冷。
    “呀！鬼手！”這是文華的第一感覺。她害怕極了，同時也完全清醒了。她清楚地感覺到那隻手的手指是那麼的冰，指甲是那麼的長。她想到了晚上看的鬼片，想到了殺死那個律師的鬼手。她害怕極了，全身都在冒著冷汗。她想叫人，但是又叫不出聲來。
    就這樣不知過了多長時間，她只覺得時間過得很慢很慢。最後，她暈過去了。
    第二天，李時醒來後，發現妻子的臉像火一樣紅，還一直在說著夢話。他摸了摸她的頭，熱度高得厲害。李時跳了起來，把文華叫醒。文華醒來後還是很害怕，她哭著告訴了李時昨天晚上發生的事情。
    一個小時後，醫生來了。醫生看了一下後，說：“她是因為受到了極度的驚嚇才生病的。現在她需要安靜地休息，不能再受到驚嚇了。像她這樣膽小的人，根本就不應該看鬼片或者是聽鬼故事。”
    在醫生給文華看病的時候，又發生了一件奇怪的事情。那個醫生發現文華的床上有一種奇怪的味道。他在文華的床旁邊找到了一塊布，那味道就是從那塊布上發出的。那是迷藥的味道。
    但是醫生不是偵探，所以他看完病後就走了。
    這時，那個不請自來的朱龍也來到了李時夫婦的家。李時把昨天晚上發生的事情告訴了朱龍。
    “為什麼會有迷藥呢？”李時感到很奇怪，他看向朱龍，說：“你是個聰明人。你來說說看吧！”
    “哈哈！這樣奇怪的事情，我哪裏知道為什麼。這要問問福爾摩斯大偵探才行了。”朱龍笑道。
    “可是中國沒有福爾摩斯。”
    “中國雖然沒有福爾摩斯，但是有霍桑大偵探呀！”
    朱龍鼓勵李時打電話給霍桑大偵探，讓他來解開這個難題。李時是個公子哥兒，他覺得打電話太麻煩。於是，朱龍找出了電話號碼，半開玩笑似的打給了霍桑。朱龍以為偵探事務所很忙，不會有時間處理這樣的小事。沒想到，電話裡說：“你們等會兒，我馬上就到。”

sentences.pinyin: tā mō le mō tā de tóu rè dù gāo de lì hai
sentences.english: He touched her head, and her temperature was incredibly high.

sentences.simplified: 李时跳了起来，把文华叫醒。
sentences.traditional: 李時跳了起來，把文華叫醒。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ shí tiào le qǐ lái bǎ wén huá jiào xǐng
sentences.english: Li Shi jumped up and woke up Wen Hua.

sentences.simplified: 文华醒来后还是很害怕，她哭着告诉了李时昨天晚上发生的事情。
sentences.traditional: 文華醒來後還是很害怕，她哭著告訴了李時昨天晚上發生的事情。
sentences.pinyin: wén huá xǐng lái hòu hái shì hěn hài pà tā kū zhe gào su le lǐ shí zuó tiān wǎn shang fā shēng de shì qing
sentences.english: Wen Hua was still very scared after waking up. Crying, she told Li Shi what had happened yesterday evening.

sentences.simplified: 一个小时后，医生来了。
sentences.traditional: 一個小時後，醫生來了。
sentences.pinyin: yí ge xiǎo shí hòu yī shēng lái le
sentences.english: An hour later, the doctor arrived.

sentences.simplified: 医生看了一下后，说：
sentences.traditional: 醫生看了一下後，說：
sentences.pinyin: yī shēng kàn le yí xià hòu shuō
sentences.english: When the doctor had seen her for a while, he said:

sentences.simplified: “她是因为受到了极度的惊吓才生病的。
sentences.traditional: “她是因為受到了極度的驚嚇才生病的。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì yīn wèi shòu dào le jí dù de jīng xià cái shēng bìng de
sentences.english: “She has fallen ill because she got extremely frightened.

sentences.simplified: 现在她需要安静地休息，不能再受到惊吓了。
sentences.traditional: 現在她需要安靜地休息，不能再受到驚嚇了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tā xū yào ān jìng de xiū xi bù néng zài shòu dào jīng xià le
sentences.english: Now she needs to rest calmly; she can’t get scared again.

sentences.simplified: 像她这样胆小的人，根本就不应该看鬼片或者是听鬼故事。”
sentences.traditional: 像她這樣膽小的人，根本就不應該看鬼片或者是聽鬼故事。”
sentences.pinyin: xiàng tā zhè yàng dǎn xiǎo de rén gēn běn jiù bù yīng gāi kàn guǐ piàn huò zhě shì tīng guǐ gù shi
sentences.english: An easily scared person like her shouldn’t watch ghost movies or hear ghost stories at all.”

sentences.simplified: 在医生给文华看病的时候，又发生了一件奇怪的事情。
sentences.traditional: 在醫生給文華看病的時候，又發生了一件奇怪的事情。
sentences.pinyin: zài yī shēng gěi wén huá kàn bìng de shí hou yòu fā shēng le yí jiàn qí guài de shì qing
sentences.english: When the doctor was giving Wen Hua a visit, something strange happened again.

sentences.simplified: 那个医生发现文华的床上有一种奇怪的味道。
sentences.traditional: 那個醫生發現文華的床上有一種奇怪的味道。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge yī shēng fā xiàn wén huá de chuáng shang yǒu yì zhǒng qí guài de wèi dào
sentences.english: That doctor discovered that Wen Hua’s bed had a strange smell.

sentences.simplified: 他在文华的床旁边找到了一块布，那味道就是从那块布上发出的。
sentences.traditional: 他在文華的床旁邊找到了一塊布，那味道就是從那塊布上發出的。
sentences.pinyin: tā zài wén huá de chuáng páng biān zhǎo dào le yí kuài bù nà wèi dào jiù shì cóng nà kuài bù shang fā chū de
sentences.english: He found a piece of cloth next to Wen Hua’s bed, and that smell was coming from that piece of cloth.

sentences.simplified: 那是迷药的味道。
sentences.traditional: 那是迷藥的味道。
sentences.pinyin: nà shì mí yào de wèi dào
sentences.english: That was the smell of knockout drops.

sentences.simplified: 但是医生不是侦探，所以他看完病后就走了。
sentences.traditional: 但是醫生不是偵探，所以他看完病後就走了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì yī shēng bú shì zhēn tàn suǒ yǐ tā kàn wán bìng hòu jiù zǒu le
sentences.english: But the doctor wasn’t a detective, so he just left when he was finished visiting the patient.

sentences.simplified: 这时，那个不请自来的朱龙也来到了李时夫妇的家。
sentences.traditional: 這時，那個不請自來的朱龍也來到了李時夫婦的家。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí nà ge bù qǐng zì lái de zhū lóng yě lái dào le lǐ shí fū fù de jiā
sentences.english: At this time, that Zhu Long who turned up uninvited also came to the Li Shi couple’s home.

sentences.simplified: 李时把昨天晚上发生的事情告诉了朱龙。
sentences.traditional: 李時把昨天晚上發生的事情告訴了朱龍。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ shí bǎ zuó tiān wǎn shang fā shēng de shì qing gào su le zhū lóng
sentences.english: Li Shi told Zhu Long what had happened yesterday evening.

sentences.simplified: “为什么会有迷药呢？”李时感到很奇怪，他看向朱龙，说：
sentences.traditional: “為什麼會有迷藥呢？”李時感到很奇怪，他看向朱龍，說：
sentences.pinyin: wèi shén me huì yǒu mí yào ne lǐ shí gǎn dào hěn qí guài tā kàn xiàng zhū lóng shuō
sentences.english: “And why were there knockout drops?” Li Shi thought it was very strange. He looked at Zhu Long, and said:

sentences.simplified: “你是个聪明人。你来说说看吧！”
sentences.traditional: “你是個聰明人。你來說說看吧！”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ shì ge cōng ming rén nǐ lái shuō shuo kàn ba
sentences.english: “You’re an intelligent person. Come on and tell me what you think!”

sentences.simplified: “哈哈！这样奇怪的事情，我哪里知道为什么。
sentences.traditional: “哈哈！這樣奇怪的事情，我哪裏知道為什麼。
sentences.pinyin: hā hā zhè yàng qí guài de shì qing wǒ nǎ lǐ zhī dào wèi shén me
sentences.english: “Haha! Something this strange, how would I know why.

sentences.simplified: 这要问问福尔摩斯大侦探才行了。”朱龙笑道。
sentences.traditional: 這要問問福爾摩斯大偵探才行了。”朱龍笑道。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yào wèn wen fú ěr mó sī dà zhēn tàn cái xíng le zhū lóng xiào dào
sentences.english: This could only be worked out by asking the great detective Sherlock Holmes.” Zhu Long said laughingly.

sentences.simplified: “可是中国没有福尔摩斯。”
sentences.traditional: “可是中國沒有福爾摩斯。”
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhōng guó méi yǒu fú ěr mó sī
sentences.english: “But there’s no Sherlock Holmes in China.”

sentences.simplified: “中国虽然没有福尔摩斯，但是有霍桑大侦探呀！”
sentences.traditional: “中國雖然沒有福爾摩斯，但是有霍桑大偵探呀！”
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó suī rán méi yǒu fú ěr mó sī dàn shì yǒu huò sāng dà zhēn tàn ya
sentences.english: “Although China doesn’t have Sherlock Holmes, there is the great detective Huo Sang!”

sentences.simplified: 朱龙鼓励李时打电话给霍桑大侦探，
sentences.traditional: 朱龍鼓勵李時打電話給霍桑大偵探，
sentences.pinyin: zhū lóng gǔ lì lǐ shí dǎ diàn huà gěi huò sāng dà zhēn tàn
sentences.english: Zhu Long encouraged Li Shi to give the great detective Huo Sang a phone call, ..

sentences.simplified: 让他来解开这个难题。
sentences.traditional: 讓他來解開這個難題。
sentences.pinyin: ràng tā lái jiě kāi zhè ge nán tí
sentences.english: .. and have him come to solve this difficult problem.

sentences.simplified: 李时是个公子哥儿，他觉得打电话太麻烦。
sentences.traditional: 李時是個公子哥兒，他覺得打電話太麻煩。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ shí shì ge gōng zǐ gē'r tā jué de dǎ diàn huà tài má fan
sentences.english: Li Shi was the pampered son of a wealthy family, he thought that it was too inconvenient to make the phone call.

sentences.simplified: 于是，朱龙找出了电话号码，半开玩笑似的打给了霍桑。
sentences.traditional: 於是，朱龍找出了電話號碼，半開玩笑似的打給了霍桑。
sentences.pinyin: yú shì zhū lóng zhǎo chū le diàn huà hào mǎ bàn kāi wán xiào shì de dǎ gěi le huò sāng
sentences.english: Consequently, Zhu Long searched out the phone number and gave Huo Sang a call seemingly half-jokingly.

sentences.simplified: 朱龙以为侦探事务所很忙，
sentences.traditional: 朱龍以為偵探事務所很忙，
sentences.pinyin: zhū lóng yǐ wéi zhēn tàn shì wù suǒ hěn máng
sentences.english: Zhu Long was under the impression that the detective office would be very busy, ..

sentences.simplified: 不会有时间处理这样的小事。
sentences.traditional: 不會有時間處理這樣的小事。
sentences.pinyin: bú huì yǒu shí jiān chǔ lǐ zhè yàng de xiǎo shì
sentences.english: .. and unlikely to have time to handle a small matter like this.

sentences.simplified: 没想到，电话里说：“你们等会儿，我马上就到。”
sentences.traditional: 沒想到，電話裡說：“你們等會兒，我馬上就到。”
sentences.pinyin: méi xiǎng dào diàn huà lǐ shuō nǐ men děng huì'r wǒ mǎ shàng jiù dào
sentences.english: Unexpectedly, the voice on the phone said: “You wait a little while, I’ll come right away.”

raw.synopsis: This is Part 2 of our rendition of “Ghost Hand”.
sentence_translations: Wen Hua had had a serious cough recently, and in order for her to not disturb her husband’s sleep, ..
.. therefore the two of them didn’t sleep on the same side, but rather slept at the two ends of the bed.
But before going to bed this evening, she asked to change places with her husband.
The reason was: the end that her husband slept at had a bedside lamp, ..
.. and that would make it convenient for her to turn on the light when not being able to sleep during the night.
As a matter of fact, it hadn’t yet been an hour, ..
.. and Wen Hua had already turned on and turned off the lamp four five times.
At the same time, she had also woken up her husband several times.
In the end, her husband got angry, and she finally didn’t dare to wake him again.
Wen Hua couldn’t sleep, or that is to say, she didn’t dare fall asleep.
She thought about that “ghost hand” all the time, and always had an uneasy feeling.
Another half-hour passed, and Wen Hua still hadn’t fallen asleep.
There was nothing to be done, she got up, found her husband’s sleeping pills, and took two.
This was very strong medication, and before long, Wen Hua fell asleep.
Not knowing how long she had slept, in the darkness, there was something that woke her up.
That was a hand lightly touching her neck.
She was half asleep and half awake, ..
.. and had forgotten that she and her husband were not sleeping on the same end of the bed.
Just as it started she was still under the impression that it was her husband touching her.
She wanted to take this hand away, but her whole body was powerless, and she couldn’t even lift a finger.
Another moment went by, and something scary happened!
She felt that there was a hand touching her neck a second time.
But this hand wasn’t the same as the first hand. This hand was very very cold, even colder than ice.
“Ah! Ghost hand!” This was Wen Hua’s first thought.
She was extremely scared and got completely clear-headed at the same time.
She clearly felt that the fingers of that hand were so cold, and the fingernails were so long.
She thought of the ghost movie they saw that evening, and thought of the ghost hand that killed that lawyer.
She was extremely scared, and her whole body gave off a cold sweat.
She wanted to cry out for someone, but not a sound came out.
She didn’t know how much time went by this way, she only thought that time passed very very slowly.
Finally, she passed out.
The next day, when Li Shi woke up, he discovered that his wife’s face was as red as fire.
She was still talking in her sleep all along.
He touched her head, and her temperature was incredibly high.
Li Shi jumped up and woke up Wen Hua.
Wen Hua was still very scared after waking up. Crying, she told Li Shi what had happened yesterday evening.
An hour later, the doctor arrived.
When the doctor had seen her for a while, he said:
“She has fallen ill because she got extremely frightened.
Now she needs to rest calmly; she can’t get scared again.
An easily scared person like her shouldn’t watch ghost movies or hear ghost stories at all.”
When the doctor was giving Wen Hua a visit, something strange happened again.
That doctor discovered that Wen Hua’s bed had a strange smell.
He found a piece of cloth next to Wen Hua’s bed, and that smell was coming from that piece of cloth.
That was the smell of knockout drops.
But the doctor wasn’t a detective, so he just left when he was finished visiting the patient.
At this time, that Zhu Long who turned up uninvited also came to the Li Shi couple’s home.
Li Shi told Zhu Long what had happened yesterday evening.
“And why were there knockout drops?” Li Shi thought it was very strange. He looked at Zhu Long, and said:
“You’re an intelligent person. Come on and tell me what you think!”
“Haha! Something this strange, how would I know why.
This could only be worked out by asking the great detective Sherlock Holmes.” Zhu Long said laughingly.
“But there’s no Sherlock Holmes in China.”
“Although China doesn’t have Sherlock Holmes, there is the great detective Huo Sang!”
Zhu Long encouraged Li Shi to give the great detective Huo Sang a phone call, ..
.. and have him come to solve this difficult problem.
Li Shi was the pampered son of a wealthy family, he thought that it was too inconvenient to make the phone call.
Consequently, Zhu Long searched out the phone number and gave Huo Sang a call seemingly half-jokingly.
Zhu Long was under the impression that the detective office would be very busy, ..
.. and unlikely to have time to handle a small matter like this.
Unexpectedly, the voice on the phone said: “You wait a little while, I’ll come right away.”
